title: 第1章 《奔跑吧初代》
slug: 综艺大导演从齐聚初代跑男开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

【本故事发生在平行世界，请勿较真】

【所有初代跑男的粉丝们，欢迎回家】

“大黑牛变老黄牛咯。”

“现在跑男撕名牌最强之人是张真远！”

吴凡刷到李辰被流量明星按在地上撕名牌的短视频。

这是上面飘过的弹幕。

“哈哈哈哈哈大黑牛现在不行了，真的好弱啊。”

“心疼辰哥，但这真的很好笑。”

“跑男现在就是养老院好吧，年纪大了真是干什么都心酸。”

“撕名牌？别逗了，现在谁敢用力撕啊，难不成想被饭圈骂？”

“一群过气老人陪小鲜肉过家家罢了。”

“李辰：我当年撕名牌的时候你们还在上小学。”

“有什么用，老了就是老了。”

吴凡攥紧手机无奈摇头，作为一个十年跑男老观众，最看不得这个场景。

曾经的大黑牛那可是人人都怕的存在。

现在呢？

谁都能欺负一下？

眼看着张真远伸手去撕名牌，李辰下意识抬手格挡，却又不敢反击。

真的很心酸。

吴凡把手机重重扣在桌上。

他今年二十二岁，传媒大学编导专业刚毕业。

跑男第一季播出的时候他还在上小学。

每个周五晚上准时守在电视机前。

看着邓朝李辰郑凯他们在泥潭里打滚，在城市里狂奔，在深夜的天台上互相撕名牌。

那是他选择学编导的初衷。

他想做出这样的节目。

但现在他想做的，是把现在这个破节目组的人全开了。

妈的，这也太欺负人了！

可就在这时，眼前的手机突然黑屏了。

还没等吴凡疑惑，手机屏幕上竟然浮现出一行金色的字。

【综艺大导演系统正在绑定中……】

什么东西？

吴凡一脸懵逼。

直到金色的光从屏幕里溢出来，爬上他的手臂。

吴凡本能地想甩开，但那些金色的光纹丝不动，像是焊在了他的皮肤上。

【绑定完成。】

【宿主：吴凡。年龄：22岁。职业：待业。】

【系统判定：当前宿主状态可执行任务。】

【任务发布：重启《奔跑吧》，集齐初代跑男阵容，恢复全民综艺巅峰。】

【任务奖励：超级体力+十年寿命。】

Page (1/3)

[This story takes place in a parallel world, please do not take it seriously]

[All fans of the original Running Man, welcome home]

"The big black cow has turned into an old scalper."

"The person who is the most powerful in running men to tear up famous brands now is Zhang Zhenyuan!"

Wu Fan saw a short video of Li Chen being pinned to the ground and tearing off his name tag by a popular celebrity.

This is the barrage floating above.

"Hahahahaha the big black bull is not good now, he is really weak."

"I feel sorry for Brother Chen, but this is really funny."

"Running Man is now a nursing home, okay? It's really sad to do anything when you get older."

"Tear off a famous brand? Don't be ridiculous. Who dares to tear it up now? Do you want to be scolded by the fans?"

"A bunch of outdated old people are just playing house with the little fresh meat."

"Li Chen: You were still in elementary school when I tore off the name tag."

"What's the use, you're just old when you're old."

Wu Fan clenched his phone tightly and shook his head helplessly. As a veteran viewer of Running Man for ten years, this scene was the most unpleasant to watch.

The former Big Black Bull was an existence that everyone was afraid of.

What now?

Can anyone be bullied?

Seeing Zhang Zhenyuan reaching out to tear off the name tag, Li Chen subconsciously raised his hand to block, but did not dare to fight back.

It's really sad.

Wu Fan slammed his phone on the table.

He is twenty-two years old and has just graduated from Communication University with a major in directing.

He was still in elementary school when the first season of Running Man aired.

Stay in front of the TV on time every Friday night.

Watching Deng Chao, Li Chen, Zheng Kai and the others wallow in the mire, run wildly in the city, and tear each other's name tags off on the rooftop late at night.

That was his original intention of choosing to study directing.

He wanted to make a show like this.

But what he wants to do now is to open up all the people in this broken program.

Damn, this is too bullying!

But at this moment, the phone screen in front of me suddenly went black.

Before Wu Fan could get confused, a line of golden words appeared on the screen of his phone.

[The variety show director system is being bound...]

What?

Wu Fan looked confused.

Until golden light overflowed from the screen and climbed up his arm.

Wu Fan instinctively wanted to shake it off, but the golden light remained motionless, as if welded to his skin.

[Binding completed.】

[Host: Wu Fan.Age: 22 years old.Occupation: Unemployed.】

[System judgment: The current host status can perform tasks.】

[Mission release: Restart "Running Man", gather the first-generation running male lineup, and restore the peak of national variety shows.】

[Task reward: super physical strength + ten years of life.】
